messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] compiler warnings
parts:
Thanks. I'll try to knock out everything but the long
long issues -- those are from 64-bit Windows defining
size_t equal to unsigned long long (unliked unsigned long
everywhere else). So I think it'll take some typedefs
to do this right or the introduction of Boost's fixed
size types (which we maybe should've been doing all along).

The variable length arrays are inside sizeof() calcs, so
that's just some arithmetic. Most of the rest looks like
extra variables and functions and missing punctuation or
spaces.

- Bob
